The HTML file is not a document that opens an app: it is the app. The code, fonts and charts are all inside it, and nothing is downloaded when you use it.

Setting up: about ten minutes

  1. Extract the ZIP into a folder you will find again. A synced folder (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) is ideal.
  2. Double-click MoneyAutopilot.html. It opens in Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox like a web page, and works offline from then on.
  3. Take the welcome tour. A few short slides on adding statements, what gets counted, and backups.
  4. Add your first statements on Add statements: last month from every card and bank, all at once.
  5. Download a backup from Settings & backup. Page 9 explains why it matters more than anything else here.

Want to look around first?

Choose Explore sample data on the welcome screen or in Settings & backup. A fictional household fills every screen, in a separate session. Return to my money brings back your own figures, untouched.

The idea

Where it went, without typing.

Money Autopilot answers one question first: how much did you keep this month?

The Money picture. Kept is money in less spending, for the month you choose at the top.

WordWhat it means
Money inPaychecks and other income.
SpendingEverything that left, less refunds.
KeptMoney in − spending.
Not countedCard payments and transfers between your own accounts. The purchases were already counted once.

Add statements

Three steps. Then it runs itself.

Download, drop in, glance. Next month takes about two minutes.

  1. Download. Sign in to each bank or card website, open the account, and choose Download or Export on the transactions list. Pick CSV (sometimes “Spreadsheet” or “Comma delimited”) and a date range.
  2. Drop them in. All files at once on Add statements. Each line is read, the merchant name cleaned up, sorted into a category, and card payments and transfers are paired.
  3. Glance. Clear the few in Needs a look, then read your money picture.

Overlaps are safe

Transactions already in the app are skipped, even when two statements overlap by a few days. Two identical purchases on the same day in one file are both kept.

CSV, not PDF

PDF statements can't be read. Almost every US bank, card, PayPal and Venmo offers a CSV download.

Sorting

It learns from you.

Change a category once and the app remembers it for that place from then on.

Transactions. Search, filter by account, category or type, and sort any column.

Something's in the wrong categoryChange it on the transaction. You're asked whether to change the others from the same place and remember it. Your choice always wins over the built-in list.
Needs a lookThe few it couldn't place wait here. Pick a category; it learns.
AccountsEach file becomes an account. Rename it, set its type (checking, card, savings…) or archive one you've closed. The type decides how money in and out is read.
Statements folderChrome and Edge: point it at your downloads folder on Add statements and new statement files come in by themselves each time you open the app.

Long card and account numbers are hidden as soon as a file is read. Only the last four digits are kept.

Subscriptions

What repeats, and what to cut.

Subscriptions and bills are found by themselves from your transactions. Nothing to set up.

Every repeating charge, what it costs a month and a year, and the date it lands next. A price increase is flagged.

Cut back

Ideas come from your own spending: a subscription, a category running above your usual. Apply one and see the monthly and yearly total, and what it grows to if you invest it.

Insights

Categories higher or lower than your usual month, new places you spent at, your biggest purchases, fees and interest, and the charges coming up in the next three weeks.

Net worth

The rest of the picture.

Savings, investments, cards and loans: what you own less what you owe.

Savings accountsDrop their transactions CSV in like checking. Money moved there from checking counts as saved, not spent.
Brokerage and retirementFrom Fidelity, Vanguard, Schwab and others, the positions or holdings download gives each account's balance; the activity download adds contributions.
Card balancesCard downloads don't include the balance. Type what you owe once with Enter balance; every statement after that keeps it current.
PaychecksYour bank only sees take-home pay. Switch on Paychecks, enter one recent pay stub per employer, and every paycheck is broken down by itself.

Read this one

Keeping your money safe.

Everything lives in your browser, on your device. Nothing is sent anywhere, there is no account, and nobody else holds a copy, including us.

Your entries live in browser storage: please read

  • Everything you enter or import is saved automatically in that browser's local storage.
  • Clearing your cache, history or site data will permanently delete it.
  • It does not carry across browsers: data added in Chrome will not appear in Safari.
  • The HTML file does not contain your entries. Copying the file does not copy your data.

Do one of these. Ideally both.

Download backup: every browser

Settings & backup → Download backup. One JSON file holding every account, transaction, category and setting. Restore backup brings it back on any computer. The app reminds you when a backup is due.

Daily folder backup: Chrome or Edge

Choose a synced folder once (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) and a dated copy is written each day you make changes. Safari and Firefox do not offer this; use Download backup instead.

Moving to another computer

Copy the HTML file and your latest backup across, open the file, then Settings & backup → Restore backup.

When you need help

A few useful fixes.

What you seeWhat to do
It opens as code, not an appExtract the ZIP first, then right-click the file → Open with → your browser.
My numbers are goneCheck it is the same browser and profile you used before. Otherwise, Restore backup.
A file wasn't recognizedCheck it is the CSV download, not a PDF. On Add statements, Map a file by hand reads any CSV.
Spending looks doubledAdd the checking account's file too, so card payments can be paired. Check each account's type on Accounts.
A category is wrongChange it on the transaction and choose to remember it.
Net worth looks offEnter each card's balance once, and add the holdings download for investment accounts.
Folder backup unavailableUse Chrome or Edge on a computer, or Download backup instead.
The currency is wrongSettings & backup → Currency, or type your own symbol. Amounts are not converted.
I want the tour againSettings & backup → Welcome tour → Show tour.
